claims.assertion: Yazhi says Lemurian Evas helped liberate Adamic people held in Atlantean facilities in Turkey, prompting flight and conflict.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She frames this as an alternative account of the Eden story.

claims.assertion: Yazhi says the ensuing Lemuria-Atlantis conflict involved spacefaring allies and nuclear warfare, culminating in Tiamat’s destruction.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: The transcript presents this as Taygetan history, without independent evidence.

review_flags: The source presents unverified alternative-history claims about ancient civilizations and warfare.
coverage_gaps: Other passages discuss Neanderthals, alleged radiological evidence, and the participants in the conflict.
